semantic-membraneSemantic MembranecompositionPROPOSED——A composed subsystem exposes exactly the state that affects externally observable future behaviour and no more (the ADEQUACY half of shared-observable, quotiented by EQUIVARIANCE).
capability-bounded-compositionCapability-Bounded CompositioncompositionWITNESSEDCHECKABLE RUNNABLE EXECUTED STAGEDAmpersandBoxDesign/box-and-box/test/laws.mjs suite · in_treeAn action is admissible only if it is feasible AND permitted under an explicit grant; feasibility never implies permission, and the safety floor cannot be weakened by composition.
carrier-confinementCarrier ConfinementcompositionSTATED——A Carrier is started with exactly the filesystem and descriptor authority its Worker's grant names; the descriptor seal is CLOSE_RANGE_CLOEXEC, never a blind close.
projection-not-duplicationProjection, Not DuplicationcompositionWITNESSEDCHECKABLE RUNNABLE EXECUTEDgraphonomous/v2/test/projection_v1.test.mjs side-effect · in_treeEvery view of a semantic artifact is derived from it by a declared, recomputable projection; a receiver recomputes the claims on the wire rather than trusting flags or prose.
refusable-divergenceRefusable DivergencecompositionWITNESSEDCHECKABLE RUNNABLE EXECUTEDWRL/test/conformance.mjs side-effect · in_treeAn implementation divergence between two verifiers of the same artifact is refused by name rather than passing silently: no flags, no prose, only claims a receiver recomputes.
progress-over-utilizationProgress Over UtilizationprogressWITNESSEDCHECKABLE EXECUTEDcomputedriven/receipts/R7-EXECUTED.md receipt · in_treeSystem health is measured by admitted semantic transitions per unit cost, never by carrier busyness; a Carrier may be fully busy while the loci it carries make no progress.
dormant-but-aliveDormant But AliveprogressSTATED—computedriven/receipts/R7.1-OPEN.md spec · specA locus with no Carrier and pending mailbox depth is fully live: its admissibility and future transitions are defined, and readiness changes without executing a floor command.
carrier-multiplexingCarrier MultiplexingprogressWITNESSEDCHECKABLE EXECUTEDcomputedriven/receipts/R7-EXECUTED.md receipt · in_treeA population of loci larger than a floor's slot count is carried by rotating loci through slots; the slot is not the unit of identity and no locus is lost by not currently holding one.
progress-aware-placementProgress-Aware PlacementprogressSTATED——A locus is placed on the home where the semantic progress it can make is greatest, not where fairness among runnable carriers is greatest.
proven-quiescenceProven QuiescenceprogressPROPOSED——A system is quiescent only when a sweep establishes that no locus has admissible pending work; silence of the currently observed carriers is not completion.
three-valued-outcomeThree-Valued OutcomeprogressSTATED——Every attempted intervention resolves to exactly one of APPLIED, REFUSED, INDETERMINATE; INDETERMINATE is a fact about an attempt and is never rewritten.
orthogonal-persistenceOrthogonal PersistenceworldSTATED——Whether a locus's state is in cache, RAM, disk or a remote node is an implementation choice below its semantic level; code is identical for short-lived and long-lived state.
three-sizes-of-worldThree Sizes of WorldworldSTATED——WORLD (the machine, 10 GB–10 TB), WORLD VERSION (a content-addressed root, KB) and WRL GRAPH (the semantic layer inside, KB–MB) are three sizes with three names; no field is called current_head — a head is always qualified.

exact-replayExact ReplayworldSTATED——A run of a sealed world is a film that replays byte-identically; any divergence on replay is a divergence of the world, not of the player.
